findings.observed_fact: The authoritative terminal state was a loss.
findings.next_test: Require a bounded replay that preserves a healthy Dustox answer before another full clone.

findings.observed_fact: Croakatoa eventually used fresh-entry Fake Out and Sludge correctly, but only after the team had lost substantial HP and tempo.
findings.next_test: Replay only the Eelektrik prefix with reserve-HP constraints and compare the first materially different safe line.

findings.observed_fact: Dustox applied Infestation in this sequence and Mud Shot did not produce a reliable finish before the endgame collapsed.
findings.next_test: Replay the turn-25 prefix once with each materially plausible legal continuation, deduplicated by state/action hash.

findings.observed_fact: The trace appears to allow a voluntary switch after a volatile trap was recorded, but the exact pre/post identity boundary needs confirmation.
findings.next_test: Inspect the saved turn-25 and turn-26 states and prove whether the switch was voluntary, forced, or already queued.

findings.observed_fact: The automatic review incorrectly treated strategy-vetoed Fake Out and forbidden alternatives as missed or dominated actions.
findings.next_test: Keep the veto-aware review regression tests and require forbidden candidates to be excluded from dominance and counterfactual queues.

findings.observed_fact: The line spent multiple turns attacking while the intended Croakatoa pivot was unsafe at the observed HP.
findings.next_test: Bounded-replay the Bite alternatives only after modeling the incoming damage and switch survival.

findings.observed_fact: The fight spent over one third of its actions switching and still reached a forced 6-HP reserve.
findings.next_test: Measure switches and reserve HP in the next clone; reject lines that add pivots without preserving a required answer.

findings.observed_fact: Ohmnomnom's two Spark actions, Lildozer's Bulldoze actions, Croakatoa's fresh Fake Out plus Sludge, and Bugatti's Poison Tail all matched their intended matchup roles.
findings.next_test: Protect these opening rules in regression fixtures while changing only the failed transition logic.

findings.observed_fact: The attempt used 20 move actions, 18 PP decrements, and 11 switches.
findings.next_test: Track these metrics on every subsequent clone and retain the safer line when terminal outcome is equal.
